Intestinal Diversity:
Prior to allo-HSCT vs. Engraftment
Compared to pre–allo-HSCT samples, samples collected at engraftment exhibited a significantly different microbial composition (PERMANOVA p = 0.002) and a marked decrease in alpha diversity (p < 0.0001). The top significantly different genera between pre allo-HSCT samples and engraftment samples included Blautia, Clostridium_IV, Roseburia, Oscillibacter, Faecalibacterium, Ruminococcus, Anaerostipes, Intestinimonas, Clostridium_XIVb, Anaerotruncus, Eggerthella, Pseudoflavonifractor, Romboutsia, Intestinibacter, Staphylococcus and Lachnospiraceae_UC. In depth sequencing identified an expansion of three staphylococci species: S. aureus (p < 0.01), S. epidermidis (p < 0.0001) and S. simulans (p < 0.0001).
